answers.explanation: You can reconfigure a router in minutes, but moving a data center takes months.
Location decides which disasters you have to plan for.
Servers turn electricity into heat, so cooling runs all day, every day.
Racks keep equipment organized, cooled, and easy to reach.
Every desk on the floor has to be within 100 m of cable from it.
That's why big floors often have more than one wiring closet.
Wired is faster and more secure, wireless is cheaper and lets people move.
Remote means less to maintain, but you depend on the network link to reach your servers.
